theorem Roth.boxFamily_finite.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (r : σ → ℕ) [Finite ↑(Function.support r)] (B : ℕ),
  (boxFamily r B).Finite :=
fun {σ} r [Finite ↑(Function.support r)] B ↦
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a.Finite) (Roth.boxFamily_eq_image_finsupp_aux✝ r B)))
    (Set.Finite.image AddMonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
      (Finset.finite_toSet
        ((Finset.Iic (Finsupp.ofSupportFinite r (Set.toFinite (Function.support r)))).finsupp fun x ↦ Finset.Icc 0 ↑B)))

BOX245_TARGET_COMPACT_BODY: fun {σ} r [Finite ↑(Function.support r)] B ↦
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a.Finite) (Roth.boxFamily_eq_image_finsupp_aux✝ r B)))
    (Set.Finite.image AddMonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
      (Finset.finite_toSet
        ((Finset.Iic (Finsupp.ofSupportFinite r (Set.toFinite (Function.support r)))).finsupp fun x ↦ Finset.Icc 0 ↑B)))
